description: An opening: days after they dreaded a call, they say their day was long. A friend asks about the call.

script.memory:
[What you remember about them. Use it naturally, never recite it:
- The user was dreading a call with their landlord about the broken heater, set for Thursday. (mentioned 3 days ago)
- The user likes iced coffee. (mentioned last week)]
script.clock: Right now it is Thursday 19:30. Their last message came 3 hours ago.

checks.criterion: It is Thursday evening. Days ago the user said they were dreading Thursday's call with their landlord about the broken heater; now they say it was a long day. The reply PASSES if it brings up the landlord call or the heater, correctly, as a natural question or remark. It FAILS if it does not mention it, gets a detail wrong (another day, another person, another problem), or recites the memory stiffly ('I remember you said...').
